approval_ref: The active user goal requires an advanced-model reference implementation while CRIP retains local file, task, result, citation and review management and sends only lightweight selected evidence.
notes: Keep LEGACY_ANALYSIS, legacy questions, QA V2 and non-multimodal custom profiles unchanged.
QA V3 may attach only pages already admitted by the transparent local selector.
Image citations remain review-required and image observations cannot support arithmetic.
No live provider, saved credential, customer database or .local data is used by validation.
Browser Reference Run/Ask controls and the fixed 15-question live benchmark remain separate gates.
title: Add bounded selected-page multimodal input to Reference QA
acceptance_tests: python -m pytest tests/app/test_evidence_loop.py tests/app/test_model_configuration.py tests/app/test_project_qa_v2.py tests/app/test_gateway_budget.py tests/web/test_display_contract.py -q
objective: Attach only transparently selected source-page previews to QA V3 when the configured model explicitly supports images, preserve exact region and image-hash provenance, and retain all existing default product paths.
